## What Needs Attention

- **Operational evidence is the main gap.** The records report that patching, backup and restore, uptime, recovery, queue and scheduler, and incident controls exist, but current evidence is missing or unknown. The current open action is to record and verify the existing IT procedures before the related risks are reassessed. ([action register](../registers/action-log.md), [risk register](../registers/risk-register.md), [closure and operations handoff](../artifacts/lead-hub-closure-report.md))
- **Activity data is not yet fully reliable for measurement.** The `v0.9.0` release notes identify false view rows after Q&A or calendar redirects and a prefetch-header mismatch. Current records keep these follow-ups in progress and keep broader activity verification open. `v0.9.1` fixed readable profile-change fields, but its release notes retain a known presentation gap for calendar reminder settings. ([`v0.9.0` release notes](https://github.com/adventistasia/lead-lab/releases/tag/v0.9.0), [`v0.9.1` release notes](https://github.com/adventistasia/lead-lab/releases/tag/v0.9.1), [action register](../registers/action-log.md), [issue register](../registers/issues-log.md))
- **Announcement delivery still needs operational proof.** The feature and its handoff were marked complete by PM direction, but provisional risks remain open for duplicate, missed, or ineligible messages; unsafe formatted content or links; and announcement load competing with other notifications. ([risk register](../registers/risk-register.md), [dependency register](../registers/dependencies-log.md))
- **Security and resilience follow-ups remain open.** Public registration and password-reset bot abuse remains a high-exposure operations risk. Patching, backup and restore, and availability evidence also remain open. These records do not report that an incident occurred; they show that the controls are not yet fully evidenced. ([risk register](../registers/risk-register.md), [closure and operations handoff](../artifacts/lead-hub-closure-report.md))
- **Post-launch impact is not yet measured.** No usage, benefit, service-level, or complete target-environment performance measures are recorded. There is also no approved schedule baseline or complete cost baseline, so this update reports delivery outcomes rather than realized benefits, formal variance, or return on investment. ([closure and operations handoff](../artifacts/lead-hub-closure-report.md), [post-launch working schedule](../artifacts/post-launch-schedule.md))

## Recommended Next Action

| Recommended next action | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| **Make operational evidence current.** Record and verify the existing patching, backup and restore, uptime, recovery, and incident procedures, then refresh the Gate 1 and operations evidence. | Converts reported controls into verifiable evidence and supports reassessment of conditional closure and open resilience risks. |
| **Protect activity-log credibility.** Complete the redirect and prefetch corrections, finish review and merge, and verify event attribution, filtering, access, and sensitive-data handling in staging before using the log for benefit measurement. | Prevents false activity counts from undermining trust in usage and benefit measures. |
| **Validate announcement delivery under operating conditions.** Confirm recipient eligibility, duplicate protection, safe rendering, queue capacity, retry behavior, monitoring, and recovery, then reassess the open announcement risks. | Confirms that stakeholder communications are safe and reliable under real operating conditions. |
| **Start a post-launch outcome view.** Track active usage, announcement delivery success and failure, activity-log data quality, incidents or service interruptions, and stakeholder or participant feedback. | Shows whether the delivered changes produce measurable usage, reliability, and stakeholder value. |
| **Refresh control timing.** The last proposed post-launch review was 2026-09-26, and no newer review date is recorded. Record the review outcome or establish a new trigger in the working schedule. ([post-launch working schedule](../artifacts/post-launch-schedule.md), [control dashboard](../project-control.md)) | Keeps the control records current and prevents the next review trigger from becoming stale. |
